request.text: One compact road-mine blast. Hard attack, short low concussive body, torn metal and grit rapidly decaying. Close, no sustained fireball. Timbre: a compressed concussive steel drum thud with torn plate debris. Close foundry steel, blunt low-mid weight, analog grit, short concrete reflection. 2 seconds. Original isolated effect; no music, no voice.
